The Most Expected IELTS Writing Questions with Band 9 Sample Answers

2023 IELTS Question on Advertising

Today we are faced with an increasing amount of advertising. To what extent does advertising influence us? What measures should be taken to protect ourselves from this influence?

These are difficult questions to answer, but they are questions that we must ask ourselves.

Advertising is everywhere. We see it on television, on the internet, on billboards, and even in the sky. It is designed to influence us, to get us to buy things that we don't need and may not even want.

This is not a new phenomenon. In the 1950s, researchers found that advertising can change people's behavior. It can affect the way we think and feel about something, and even the way we act.

Researchers have learned that advertising can increase the amount of products people buy, and that it can even change our preferences. Today, we are exposed to more advertising than ever before. It has become a leading cause of stress.

It is clear that advertising affects our lives in a variety of ways. Therefore, it is important to be aware of the influence that it has on us, to remain vigilant and aware of what we are thinking and feeling, and to understand that we must take measures to protect ourselves from this influence.

For some, this may mean limiting the amount of time they spend watching television, reading magazines, or surfing the internet. For others, it may mean avoiding advertisements altogether. For those who want to take their protection from advertising a step further, there are devices that can be fitted to televisions, which will change the channel whenever an advertisement is about to appear.

Furthermore, we must develop strategies to combat the effects of advertising. This may mean resisting the urge to buy things that we don't need. It might mean not reading fashion magazines or watching television shows that will make us feel less satisfied with our looks. It may also mean avoiding doing certain things we like altogether. After all, our peace is more important than a new piece of clothing we want to buy!

The increase in the production of consumer goods results in damage to the natural environment.
What is the cause of this?
What can be done to solve this problem?

The increase in the production of consumer goods has caused serious damage to the natural environment. The main reason for this is the use of non-renewable resources in the production process. If this trend continues, it could lead to a serious ecological crisis.

One possible solution to this problem is to find alternative resources that can be used in the production process. This could include using recycled materials, or renewable resources such as solar or wind power.In countries likes India, in large part due to the poorer populace, alternative energy sources such as wind and solar are becoming popular more because of the reduced cost rather than their purported ecological benefits. But no matter what the reason is, implementing these will definitely benefit the world.

Another solution is to change the production process so that it requires fewer resources. For example, steps could be taken to reduce the amount of packaging used in products. This is not only good for the environment, but also reduces the cost to consumers.

One less common solution could be to ask companies to limit their production. While this might not be popular with capitalists, this solution, while seemingly extreme, will solve the problem at the root level.

It is important that people try to reduce the impact of consumer goods on the natural environment. This is something that everyone can do, not just the government or big companies. It is up to each individual person to take action to stop the use of non-renewable resources.

In many countries, traditional dress and costumes are considered effective ways of maintaining links with the past. How effective can traditional costumes be, in this sense? In what other ways can people connect with a country’s past?

Traditional dress and costumes are an important way for people in many countries to connect with their past. From elaborate Highland dress in Scotland to the vibrant and intricately designed costumes worn by the Maasai people of Kenya, traditional dress serves both to highlight and preserve the rich cultural heritage of a country.

In addition to connecting us with our past, traditional costumes can also be vehicles for promoting and showcasing important cultural traditions. The elaborate dresses worn by performers in traditional dances like the Flamenco often incorporate materials, motifs, and designs that reflect the country’s folklore and history. They are made from locally-sourced materials thus helping support and promote the traditions of a country.

There are, of course, other ways that people can connect with their past. For example, many people choose to visit historical sites or museums, or to read books or watch films that tell stories about their country’s past.

One of the most famous traditional celebrations in the world is the annual Running of the Bulls in Pamplona, Spain. The event draws thousands of people from around the world each year to watch and participate in the festival. Dating back to the 13th century, the festival has grown significantly over the years, and today involves several days of parades, bullfights, bull-running, music, and dancing.

While it’s hard to imagine that such a dangerous tradition could be a fun experience, thousands of people still continue to take part in it in an attempt to be close to the roots.

Ultimately, it is up to each individual to decide how to most meaningfully connect to their country’s rich history.

You have just read an article in an international fitness magazine which contained some information about a health issue that is incorrect.
Write a letter to the editor of the magazine. In your letter,
‣ correct the information in the article,
‣ explain why it is important for the magazine to give correct information
‣ suggest what the magazine should do about this situation.

Dear Editor,

I recently read an article in your magazine about the dangers of consuming too much protein and I noticed that some of the information provided was incorrect. Specifically, the article stated that consuming more than the recommended daily intake of protein can lead to kidney damage. However, the correct information is that consuming high amounts of protein can be harmful for people who already have kidney disease. But for healthy individuals, consuming protein within the recommended daily intake is beneficial and it's not harmful to the kidneys.

As a fitness magazine, it is important for you to provide accurate and reliable information to your readers. Misinformation can lead to confusion and potentially harmful health decisions. It is essential that the magazine takes responsibility for the accuracy of the information it publishes, and take steps to ensure that the information is correct.

I would suggest that the magazine issues a correction in the next issue to inform readers of the mistake and provide the correct information. Additionally, the magazine should consider implementing a fact-checking process for all articles before they are published. This will help to ensure that the information provided is accurate and reliable.

I hope that the magazine will take this situation seriously and take the necessary steps to provide accurate information to its readers in the future. Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,

Some children are using AI to do their home work. Why is this the case? Do you think this is a positive or a negative development?

There are a few potential reasons why children might be using AI to do their homework. One possibility is that they find it to be a more efficient and convenient way to complete assignments or research projects. For example, a child might use an AI-powered tool to quickly find information or generate a bibliography for a report. Additionally, AI-powered tools like me can also be useful in helping children with language-based tasks such as grammar, spell checking and even writing.

Another possibility is that children are using AI to cheat on their homework. For example, there are AI-powered apps and websites that can generate answers to specific questions or even complete entire assignments. While it might seem like an easy way to get good grades, it's important to note that cheating can have serious consequences and it is considered an unethical behavior.

It's important to consider whether the use of AI in this way is a positive or negative development. On one hand, if children are using AI as a tool to assist them in their learning and understanding of the material, then it could be seen as a positive development. Children may be able to learn more, faster and more efficiently with the help of AI. On the other hand, if children are using AI solely to cheat on their homework and avoid actually learning the material, then it would be a negative development. In this case, children would not be developing a deep understanding of the material and would be missing out on the opportunity to learn and grow.

In conclusion, the use of AI in children's homework could be both positive and negative, depending on how it is used. It's essential to ensure that children are using AI in a responsible and ethical way, such as using it as a tool to assist their learning, rather than as a means of cheating. Furthermore, it's important for educators and parents to provide guidance and monitor the usage of AI by children to ensure that the technology is being used in a beneficial way for their learning and development.

Cities that attract a lot of visitors are usually expensive to live in. Why is this the case? Is this a positive or a negative development?

Cities that attract a lot of visitors tend to be expensive to live in because they are in high demand. As more people visit a city, the demand for housing, goods, and services increases, which can drive up prices. Additionally, many tourist destinations also tend to be popular places to live, which can further drive up the cost of living.

This can be a positive development in some ways, as it can lead to economic growth and job creation in the city. The influx of tourists can lead to the development of new hotels, restaurants, and other businesses, which can provide jobs and income for local residents. Additionally, higher property values can also lead to increased revenue for local governments through property taxes.

However, there are also negative aspects to this development. The high cost of living can make it difficult for low-income residents to afford to live in the city, which can lead to displacement and gentrification. Additionally, the influx of tourists can also lead to overcrowding and strain on local infrastructure and resources. The high demand for goods and services can also lead to inflated prices, which can make it difficult for local residents to afford necessities like housing and groceries.

Overall, while the high cost of living in tourist-heavy cities can have positive economic effects, it can also have negative impacts on the well-being of local residents. It is important for city leaders and policymakers to consider both the economic benefits and the potential negative impacts of tourism when developing policies and plans for managing growth and development in their cities.
